title: The relative Proj of a finitely presented graded algebra is of finite presentation with finitely presented twists
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a finitely presented quasi-coherent graded algebra the relative Proj is a morphism of finite presentation and its twists are finitely presented modules (statement lines 7845-7853). The counted proof is a clean reduction: affine locally it writes a graded presentation of the algebra, replaces the base ring by the finitely generated subring generated by the coefficients of the defining polynomials, uses compatibility of relative Proj with base change to reduce to that Noetherian model, applies the finite type statement for relative Proj there, and upgrades finite type to finite presentation using that the model is Noetherian (proof lines 7855-7886). It is H2: the reduction and both upgrades are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard base change and Noetherian finiteness statements.
